title: hover detail overlay timing
rule: Hover detail overlay timing — 0.5 s delay on mouseover; close immediately on mouse-out.

citation.source: Ant Design — Stay on the Page

pass_when: Detail overlay appears after 0.5 s hover; closes immediately on mouse-out.
fail_when: Instant open, delayed close, or no 0.5 s delay.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
